_note: Role/pool config for the role-based core (roster_revision_2026-07.md). Each role is a job the book needs done, backed by a candidate `pool` and one `selected` incumbent. `selected` here is the BASELINE/PIN, not the live authority (session 2026-07-27, blanket auto-switch): the collector's `sleeve_selection` scorecard scores pool members deterministically, and a `switch_signal` on an UNPINNED role now auto-advances the EFFECTIVE incumbent via the `SleeveSelectionState` table (logged as a `sleeve_switch` OverrideHistory row, graded by Phase C vs the incumbent counterfactual) — no human commit is required for it to take effect. An OPTIONAL per-role `"pin": true` disables auto-switch for that role entirely (config wins every run, exactly like the pre-2026-07-27 doctrine); omitted/false is the default (auto-switch enabled). An unpinned role whose `selected` here changes via a human-committed edit is adopted as freshly authoritative on the NEXT run (D-G2) — a stale in-flight auto-switch is never silently preferred over a fresh config commit. A challenger inside `LEGACY_EXITS` is never adopted regardless of streak (core re-entry is closed to those names). The ONE role exempt from all of this is `intl_leader`, whose selected member follows the rotation `leader_pick` automatically (a rotation decision, not a fund-quality decision; logged to OverrideHistory layer `intl_leader_rotation`) — `pin` has no effect on it. `block` drives the Amplifier/Damper resolution in quadrants.py (amplifier_us / amplifier_intl / damper / cash). `quadrants` is a list of Q1-Q4 for quadrant-governed roles, or the literal "rotation" for the two intl roles (sized by intl_governance, not the US quadrant). `expense_ratio` is the static ER penalty (percent) used by the selection scorecard.

selection_config._note: Momentum blend + ER penalty for the sleeve_selection scorecard, and the hysteresis gate. A challenger must lead the incumbent by >= hysteresis_lead for >= hysteresis_runs consecutive runs before a switch_signal fires. Since 2026-07-27 that switch_signal auto-advances the role's EFFECTIVE selected incumbent when the role is unpinned (see the top-level _note's `pin` doctrine) — hysteresis_lead/hysteresis_runs are therefore now the sole brake on autonomous switching, unchanged by this feature (no size gate was added; Jorge's decision, 2026-07-27). A member is ineligible when its 120d return correlation to the role benchmark_proxy < min_benchmark_corr.

intl_config._note: International sizing ladder (intl_governance). sleeve = intl_broad base + a rotation-sized intl_leader slot. See roster_revision_2026-07.md §4.
